newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar steady as market awaits quota news.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar steady as market awaits quota news.

text.p: Sugar prices held steady in a narrow range on Tuesday, dealers said.
"Volume was thin as major players kept on the sidelines awaiting announcement of the free sale quota for next month," one broker said.
Ready delivery sugar S-30 was steady at 1,450/1,465 rupees a quintal, so was sugar M-30 at 1,475/1,505 rupees.

Sugar mill delivery slid by 5/10 rupees to 1,390/1,405 rupees per quintal for the S-30 variety and to 1,410/1,430 rupees per quintal for the M-30 variety due to absence of outstation buying at the mill level.
Free sale quota for current month is 800,000 tonnes and market is expecting a quota of 750,000/775,000 tonnes for July.
